institution: Black Cultural Centre for Nova Scotia
accessNote: Visit during the weekday hours posted on the Visit Us page, or contact the Centre to submit materials.
rights_statement: Check the BCCNS website. ROOTS does not assert rights.
imageCredit: No image shown: thumbnails need permission from the holding institution.
sourceNote: The 1983 opening date comes from a Nova Scotia government release and The Canadian Encyclopedia, not from this page.
